name: Classy
description: Classy, now GoFundMe Pro, is a nonprofit fundraising platform for campaigns, donation pages, peer-to-peer fundraising, events, recurring giving and supporter management.
agentUseSummary: Classy is visible as a provider-access preview. Relay will not request credentials or expose agent actions until GoFundMe Pro grants developer application access and confirms the production authorization contract.

capabilities.label: Access authorized fundraising data
capabilities.description: After GoFundMe Pro grants Relay developer access and approves its production application, expose only reviewed fundraising capabilities within the authorized organization.

blocked.label: Connect before developer access
blocked.description: Relay has not been granted a GoFundMe Pro developer application or approved production authorization contract.

blocked.label: Collect unapproved application credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not collect client credentials or member grants created for an unreviewed or single-customer application.

blocked.label: Expose people and financial data before review
blocked.description: Supporters, transactions, recurring plans, answers, addresses, payment data and fundraising totals remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Run agent actions before contract review
blocked.description: No campaign, supporter, transaction, fundraising, webhook, mutation or raw API action is callable before provider approval and field-level review.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider access required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable until GoFundMe Pro grants developer application access and the authorization contract is reviewed.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable until GoFundMe Pro grants and approves Relay's production developer application.
No Hermes tools are callable until GoFundMe Pro grants and approves Relay's production developer application.

providerSetup.blocker: The current GoFundMe Pro developer portal offers Developer Log In and Request Access rather than documenting self-service creation and multi-customer distribution for a Relay production application.
providerSetup.nextAction: Request GoFundMe Pro developer access through the official portal. Obtain written confirmation of the production application, authorization grants, organization binding, token lifecycle, scopes, rate limits, webhook signing and permitted data fields before implementing bounded tools.

evidence.supports: The current official developer entry point presents Developer Log In and Request Access, so Relay cannot assume self-service or distributable application authorization.

GoFundMe Pro documents organization-scoped campaign endpoints with OAuth2Application or OAuth2Member authorization and explicit page/per_page controls, alongside broad supporter, transaction and mutation resources requiring contract review.
The official API documents campaign list and exact campaign resources, but access remains contingent on an approved developer application.
